plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-14 from the official Salem College 2026-2027 Undergraduate Catalog (current edition, catoid=34), Spanish Major (BA) program page (poid=945). Salem College publishes major requirements but no official semester sequence for this program (its Print Degree Planner is a blank worksheet), so the plan is collected in requirements_only form as a single block. The full degree requirements, including the Salem Impact core (published separately in the same catalog), are not itemized here. Per-course credits are the Hour(s) values printed on each course's own official course detail page in the same catalog; the program page itself prints no per-course credits. Prerequisites naming courses outside this plan are disclosed in these notes and are not recorded as plan prerequisites. The introduction states a minimum of 27 semester hours is required for the major, that all Spanish courses offered above SPAN 020 may count toward the major, and that at least three of the required Spanish courses, including at least one 200- or 300-level course, must be completed at Salem; if the student is placed above any of the required courses, the lower courses are waived and the student completes 27 semester hours starting from the appropriate level. The Required courses block carries the printed note 'No more than 6 semester hours total of Independent Study may be used toward the major.' The recorded total (27) is the exact printed minimum: the four named required courses at 12 plus five elective slots at 3 each. Prerequisites recorded only where every named course is a fixed course in this plan: SPAN 206 requires SPAN 105. Disclosed, not recorded: SPAN 030's printed prerequisite is 'SPAN 020 or placement by Program Director' and SPAN 105's is 'SPAN 030 or placement by Program Director' (each a one-of with a non-course placement alternative; SPAN 020 is not a course in this plan).

courses.title: Spanish Elective (above SPAN 105)
courses.choice_note: One additional SPAN elective course above SPAN 105, as printed ('Additional SPAN elective courses above SPAN 105 to reach a minimum of 27 semester hours'). Recorded at 3 Hour(s), the value at which the named fixed courses in this plan are printed. The program page names no individual elective course, so no options are listed here. A completion using an elective printed above 3 hours totals more than the recorded total, as printed.
